answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A sable ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A cedar expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A beacon renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 1563 identities cost 747 paid peers, 163881 tokens of stake and 51532 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
